t: This is East Heath Road, a street in Hampstead, in the London Borough of Camden. It's linked with the philosopher C. E. M. Joad, who died here. Joad was an English philosopher, author and teacher who became a broadcasting personality, appearing on the BBC wartime discussion programme The Brains Trust. He popularised philosophy and became a celebrity, before his downfall in a scandal over an unpaid train fare in 1948.
